url: for the keys that open a page.
NoticeAction.title: NoticeAction

PlanOffer.description:
A plan operation's answer: a question to show (prompt: kind confirm | pick | choose, plus its words) and the
plan_id to answer on POST /v1/plans/{plan_id}; or, with plan_id null, a refusal (kind refusal: title and body).
PlanOffer.title: PlanOffer

get.description: Ordered job events. `id` is the seq, `event` the type. Reconnect with Last-Event-ID to continue.

post.description: Ask the job to stop (it ends with a `cancelled` event). Idempotent: a job that is over just reports its state.
Answer a plan the client was offered: runs it once. Errors: unknown_plan, plan_expired, plan_stale.
Answer a question a running job or the Launch flow asked (a `prompt` event). Error: unknown_prompt.
